records.reasoning: The selected bound printed works are separate books; the accounting-records sense of books is not selected.
Weaponry is the lexical plural use of arms, distinct from countable body parts and individual armaments described with other nouns.

The broad merchandise definition permits both individual economic goods (countable good, normally plural) and goods as lexical plural merchandise. Both are directly attested for this same domain, so the prompt must distinguish individual commodities from the collective category.
The selected set of steps connecting levels is lexical plural stairs, distinct from a single stair as one step.
A mayor is one office-holder, and the source explicitly supplies the plural mayors.
The physics discipline is explicitly uncountable dynamics. Musical volume and interacting forces are separately documented plural uses.
The selected drawn stories/books are separate comics. The mass medium called comics is a different use and must not supply the answer for this definition.
The selected fabrics are separate textiles or types of textile. The dictionary distinguishes this countable cloth sense from the lexical plural name of the industry or subject.
The selected bib-and-straps garment is explicitly plural-only in North American/Australian usage; a separate overall can be a different protective garment.
Both selected regional garment senses have plural-only lexical forms. The plural of pant meaning a breath is unrelated.
Good wishes and greetings are the lexical plural regards, not separately countable respects or considerations.
Historical relics are explicitly a lexical plural remains sense; no transfer from the rare countable noun remain is needed.
Quick practical thinking is the explicit plural wits use in the learner dictionary. Humorous wit and witty people have other countability patterns.
The selected the dead refers collectively to people who have died and is explicitly plural-only. Uncountable dead of night and countable mining waste are unrelated senses.
Protective eyewear exactly matches the explicitly plural-only goggles senses; a generic plural pointer does not establish a conflicting countability for this selected device.
An internal mechanism is the explicitly lexical plural workings sense, not separate calculations or workings of a mine.
Regions outside the capital are the conventional lexical expression the provinces, distinct from separately countable administrative provinces.

The selected obligations are individual liabilities. This differs from liability as abstract legal responsibility, which can be uncountable; dictionary financial obligations explicitly have countable, usually plural behaviour.
The selected underwear is a plural garment expression, normally counted with pair, not the abstract occurrence of an individual panty component.
The selected harmful acts or things are individually countable evils. Evil as abstract moral badness is a different mass use.
Edible green vegetables or plant parts match the dedicated plural-only greens senses. Colours, golf areas and environmentalists under green are unrelated.
The selected collective category of distilled alcoholic drinks is explicitly recorded as lexical plural spirits. This is separate from countable ghosts and a particular spirit as a type of drink.
Individual binding rules are countable laws. The abstract system or body of law can be mass, but that is a different use.
The definition selects difficult things or obstacles, which can be individual difficulties. Abstract difficulty as a degree of hardness is not the selected object-like meaning.
Plates holding food are individual dishes. The plural-only dishwashing activity is not selected; the relevant vessel sense is counted as a dish and dishes.
Grateful feelings are conventionally expressed by plural thanks. The recorded singular thank is obsolete; that historical exception should not change the normal modern learner form.
Association membership fees are the explicitly labelled lexical plural dues. The definition is not an individual entitlement or payment under another due sense.
The published meeting record is the explicitly plural-only proceedings sense, distinct from countable individual actions or proceedings.
Affected manners are the lexical plural airs. Air as atmosphere, an impression, and a tune have different countability and must not be merged here.
The selected learning/literature sense is conventionally letters. It is not the regular plural of a written character or message; agreement may be singular or plural in this lexical use.
The selected total monetary value sold is the lexical plural sales, not separately counted transactions.
The selected protective eyewear is a plural instrument expression, distinct from a single sunglass lens.
People who read a publication are individual readers; reading glasses are a different plural-headword sense.

Sports dictionaries distinguish the activity (uncountable singles) from an individual singles game (countable, unchanged plural); other dictionaries classify the surface form as plural-only. The stored game definition fits an event reading, but a context-free binary quiz would unfairly reject attested usage.
The selected multiplier/comparison unit is the explicitly countable ratio sense of time. This differs from times as an era or biographical circumstances.
The outer urban area conventionally uses plural outskirts. The source records normally plural and a rare singular outskirt, so a strict claim that no singular ever exists would be too strong.
The forest sense permits a wood as a countable noun and woods as its plural or plural-form alternative. Do not mark woods as exclusively plural-only or transfer uncountable timber to this sense.
The definition describes the smouldering remains as a whole, directly matching lexical plural embers rather than an individually counted glowing fragment.
The selected studies/humanities use is explicitly plural-only arts, rather than a separately countable skill or art form.
The selected collective military force uses troops as a lexical plural. A countable cavalry troop or individual soldier is not the same displayed collective expression.
The projecting roof edge is the explicitly labelled lexical plural eaves. The separately registered plural-of-eave form does not replace the directly matching eaves sense.
The selected recently married couple is the lexical plural newlyweds. A newlywed can name one person, but that is not the displayed couple meaning.
An individual leg-covering garment is a stocking. The selected garments are its plural, not a regional plural-only word for pantyhose.
The selected wearable two-lens device is the plural-only spectacles sense of glasses. Drinking vessels and glass material are different senses.
The selected written documents are individual papers. This does not transfer uncountable paper material or the specialised lexical plural for identity documents.
A misleading appearance is an individual guise, with guises as its plural. The plural-only Internet misspelling of guys is a different homograph.
The selected enduring artistic works are individual classics, explicitly connected to the count noun classic. The plural-only academic discipline classics is a different sense.
The definition selects raised skin patches, and the source explicitly records singular hive alongside normally plural hives. Normally plural is not plural-only; individual patches can be counted.
Both bodily legs are two individual limbs, explicitly the plural of countable leg. Wine streaks, a bingo number and continuing success are separate lexical plural uses.
The words of a song are the explicitly attested lexical plural lyrics; separate lyric poems are a different countable use.
The chamber-pot sense has an explicit ordinary plural pos. The unrelated police slang is the plural-only homograph.

The stored definition describes managing money, which is directly attested for finance. The checked dedicated finances entry instead denotes financial resources. A generic plural-of-finance pointer does not establish this activity sense for finances; resolve the sense/headword alignment before assigning countability.
The displayed definition describes an individual hanging curtain cloth. The source directly attests a drape meaning a curtain with plural drapes, rather than requiring a collective-only reading.

An autobiographical account can be a memoir; memoirs also conventionally denotes a personal life account in plural form. Both are attested for the selected domain. A question must distinguish an individual account from the lexical plural expression.
The library storage area is the lexical plural the stacks. The cached plural-only money sense is unrelated; the primary learner dictionary directly confirms the library-area plural use.
The connected pair of wrist restraints matches the explicit plural-only handcuffs sense. The selected item is the pair-shaped device, not one separately named cuff.

The displayed fellow-members definition does not distinguish individual religious brothers (whose attested plural is brethren) from the lexical collective brethren. Both source analyses fit; a question needs to specify individuals or the collective body.

The stored definition describes a commercial accommodation business such as a hotel. The dedicated lodgings senses identify rented rooms or a residence, not the business entity. Generic lodging as a place can be counted, but that does not resolve this plural headword and business-entity definition safely.
Individual drops from the eyes are countable tears; the source is the eye-liquid homograph, not a rip.
The selected skeletal structures are individual bones. The source explicitly distinguishes them from bone as uncountable material.
The sharp projections of a tool are individual teeth, the irregular plural of tooth. Enforceability and unrelated slang senses do not apply.

The cutting tool is conventionally a plural instrument noun, even for one pair. Its countable tag describes separate tools, while other uncountable manoeuvre senses are unrelated. Do not conflate object countability with a singular-form noun.
The selected noun expression for other people is explicitly entered as a lexical plural. This decision does not classify the related pronoun or every nominal use of other.
Foodstuffs and household supplies are explicitly the lexical plural groceries. The separate ordinary plural of grocery refers to stores, not these purchases.

The selected second-of-two expression is normally the latter, analysed as a pronoun or nominal adjective. It can refer to a person, thing or plural set; a common-noun countability question would misrepresent it. A pronoun POS is a possible learner-facing correction, not the only grammatical analysis.
Individual details are countable particulars, while particulars also has a conventional lexical plural details sense. The current broad meaning does not distinguish these analyses.
The selected short underpants are the directly attested lexical plural briefs. Legal documents and summaries called briefs are other senses and do not supply the answer.
The nutritional substances are individual minerals. The separate slang plural referring to courage or testicles is irrelevant.
Archaeological investigations or sites are individual digs. The unrelated lexical plural digs meaning accommodation does not determine the answer.
The medical condition is the lexical plural piles, not countable heaps.
The selected race or sporting discipline is hurdles in lexical plural form. Physical obstacles are countable hurdles, but that is not this selected definition.
A drum kit is the lexical plural traps, not separately counted devices for catching animals.
The selected preparations for appearance and skin are explicitly the plural-only products sense of cosmetics. The uncountable study of cosmetics is not selected.
The selected event or display is the dedicated plural-only fireworks sense, not individual explosive devices called fireworks.
The general circumstances or situation are the lexical plural things, not separately counted physical objects.
The gripping tool is a plural instrument expression, normally quantified with pair. The ordinary plural form relation does not change this selected lexical use.
The general appearance meaning matches lexical plural looks. Individual glances, facial expressions or separately chosen styles called a look are different contextual uses.
The gripping instrument is the lexical plural tongs, normally counted with pair. The unrelated societies and other tong meanings do not apply.
Necessary things are individual essentials, linked to countable essential meaning a necessary ingredient. The lexical plural the essentials meaning basic information is not the selected meaning.

The stored definition describes human voice or speech generally; it does not clearly identify discrete words or utterances. Neither the argument/lyrics plural senses nor the mass news sense can be assigned without changing the selected concept. Clarify the bilingual meaning before classification.
The selected provisions kept ready are the lexical plural supplies. Abstract supply and individual deliveries have different countability behaviour.

The selected musical directing activity is a legitimate mass activity noun. The cached noun gloss synonymous with conductive is unrelated and is not lexical evidence for this sense. Classification here is an explicit editorial grammatical analysis of the attested musical activity, not a quoted dictionary countability label.
Plant roots are individual anatomical structures. The separate ancestry/origins use of roots does not control this definition.
The selected two-player-per-side sport is the lexical plural doubles. Countability of an individual match should be expressed with doubles match, not inferred from the unrelated sandwich sense.
The stored instructions for reaching a place or doing something match the dedicated plural-only directions sense. Geometrical directions or abstract guidance under direction are different uses.
The selected twelve-month periods are individual years. The separate lexical plural meaning a very long time is not selected.
The stored meaning explicitly says periods of twenty-four hours and plural of day. Those are individual countable days, not the lexical plural for an era or a lifetime.
Each endpoint is an extreme; the selected opposite ends are the plural of that countable noun.
Stage and film objects are separate props. The slang lexical plural meaning praise is unrelated.
The selected straps are countable reins, usually used in the plural. The cached kidneys/loins homograph is unrelated and cannot establish this meaning.
The selected routine of visiting patients is the lexical plural rounds. A separate individual round or visit is a different construction.
The selected last matches are separate finals. A tournament final is a countable event, even when several finals collectively form its last stage.
Separate residential districts are countable suburbs. The same surface form also occurs collectively as the suburbs; this does not make the base suburb uncountable.
Small amounts or portions are individual bits. The source explicitly connects bits to bit, whose relevant senses are countable; slang genital and neighbourhood uses are unrelated.
The long-duration use is explicitly countable: an age and ages. It is distinct from uncountable age as ageing or seniority.

The selected Korean percussion instrument is an individual object. The National Palace Museum catalogue independently uses the indefinite article with eo, directly confirming a countable use rather than relying on spelling or an invented plural.
The selected upper and lower structures are each a jaw, so this is a countable plural. The broader mouth-and-teeth expression jaws is a separate lexical plural use.

The stored sense is care work as an activity, analysed as uncountable. Separate episodes can be individuated as tendings in other constructions, but that does not change this generic work sense. The source confirms the sense; the countability classification is explicit editorial grammatical analysis.
The selected courage/determination meaning is explicitly plural-only guts. Physical gut or string material are other senses.
Apparel is the directly attested lexical plural clothes. The obsolete plural of cloth is separately labelled and does not describe the selected modern clothing use.

The broad lower-body clothing definition permits separately countable garments (a bottom) and the lexical plural bottoms for trousers or similar garments. The displayed meaning does not distinguish these, so neither should be rejected without added context.
Social connections are separate ties; this countable connection sense is explicitly present in the base lemma.
The selected geographical area is the lexical plural waters. This is not a countable serving of water or uncountable water as a substance.
Careful effort uses the fixed plural pains, distinct from countable painful sensations.
The selected useful objects are individual articles. The unrelated breeches and articling senses in the plural-headword row do not determine this use.
The selected animal appendages are separately countable wings. Lexical plural uses such as a pilot badge or harness do not apply.

Pay can be a countable wage and the conventional lexical plural wages for income. The broad selected definition covers both constructions; a single mutually exclusive C/plural answer is not justified.
Valuable property items are individual assets. The plural headword explicitly permits singular asset, so normally plural must not be mistaken for plural-only.

The definition selects things or concerns affecting a person rather than abstract welfare or loan interest. These are individual interests, normally used in the plural; the source distinguishes benefit and stakes from the unrelated collective group of interested persons.

The definition selects concrete buildings, equipment or services provided for a purpose, which can be individual facilities. The euphemistic lexical plural for toilets is not what this general definition specifies.
A method is a countable means with unchanged plural means. Financial resources is the separate plural-only homograph and is not the selected meaning.
The selected temporary lodging is the explicitly labelled US lexical plural accommodations, not an individual act of accommodating.
The definition identifies an expression of sympathy; the source explicitly marks that expression sense countable and normally plural. The abstract sympathy sense of condolence is separate.
Social etiquette is the lexical plural manners, distinct from separately countable ways or methods.

The stored definition explicitly combines the communication method and its machine. The relevant fax homograph permits uncountable medium use and countable device use; hair and nonstandard facts are unrelated.

The stored prison meaning is metonymic and normally occurs in behind bars. The checked bare-headword bars senses concern gymnastics, while bar has physical barrier senses. These do not establish a countability answer for the stored bare prison meaning; verify the idiomatic scope first.

British individual confections are countable sweets, but the same food category is also recorded as lexical plural confectionery. The broad current definition does not exclude either analysis; avoid a single forced answer.

For human facial hair, dictionaries attest both one beard hair as a whisker and the collective lexical plural whiskers. Do not infer this only from the separate animal-hair sense; the selected human sense permits both analyses depending on context.
Money available as financial resources is the dedicated lexical plural funds sense. Individual investment pools or organisations called a fund are separate uses.
The eyewear is a lexical plural instrument expression, normally counted in pairs. Spectacle as a notable sight is another sense.
The chronological historical record is the lexical plural annals. A single annual entry called an annal does not determine this collective history sense.

The displayed definition describes troops arranged in rows. A military row is an individual line in the base entry; the dedicated plural lines can instead denote extended defensive positions. The selected row formation supports countable lines.
The meeting record is the lexical plural minutes, not separate sixty-second intervals.

The result/data reading has explicit lexical plural evidence; the academic discipline is uncountable. The current definition also describes the act of calculation, so that broad wording should be narrowed or contextualised before single-answer grading.
This is an attested temporal noun use, not a tagging error. Its fixed reference to that time does not support an ordinary count-versus-mass exercise; do not manufacture a binary answer.
The selected collective field comprising languages, culture, history and philosophy is the explicit plural-only humanities sense, not one individual academic subject called a humanity.
The short trousers are the plural garment sense. Production remnants, short films and other short nouns are not selected.
A treaty partner state is an individual ally; the source supplies allies as the plural. The obsolete collective kinship use is a different sense.
Accommodation is the lexical plural quarters, not four equal fractions of a whole.
The denim trousers are explicitly the plural-only jeans sense, with jean available as an attributive form rather than the ordinary singular name of this garment.

Painful contractions can be individual cramps, while cramps also names the collective abdominal or uterine condition in a lexical plural entry. The displayed definition covers both, so added event-versus-condition context is needed.
